description: Updates a Sitecore data template over the Authoring and Management API. Sections and fields carrying an ID are updated; those without one are created. Matching is by ID only, never by name: to add a field to a section that already exists you must pass that section's templateSectionId (read it as itemTemplateSectionId from authoring-get-item-template), otherwise the call is rejected for creating a second section of the same name. Nothing is removed unless deleteMissingFields is true — and when it is, every section and field absent from this call is deleted, along with the content stored in them, so read the template first.

baseTemplates.description: GUIDs of templates to inherit from. This replaces the current list rather than adding to it.

createStandardValuesItem.description: When true, create the __Standard Values item if the template does not have one.

database.description: The database holding the template. Defaults to master.

deleteMissingFields.description: When true, delete every section and field not named in this call, discarding their content. Off by default.

icon.description: A new icon for the template.

language.description: The language to write template text in.

name.description: A new name for the template. Omit to leave it unchanged.

sections.description: Sections to update or add. Include templateSectionId / templateFieldId to update rather than create.

defaultValue.description: The value new items get for this field.

sortOrder.description: Position of the field within its section.

source.description: The field's data source, e.g. a datasource path or query for a Droplink.

templateFieldId.description: The GUID of an existing field to update. Omit to create a new field.

title.description: The label shown to authors instead of the field name.

type.description: The Sitecore field type, e.g. 'Single-Line Text', 'Rich Text', 'Image', 'Droptree'. Required when creating a field.

validationText.description: The message shown when validation fails.

sortOrder.description: Position of the section within the template.

templateSectionId.description: The GUID of an existing section to update. Omit to create a new section.

templateId.description: The GUID of the template to update.

name: authoring-update-item-template
